name: 5-MeO-DiPT
summary: 5-methoxy-di isopropyl tryptamine, also known as 'foxy', a psychedelic tryptamine related to DMT. The drug is reported to distort visual and audio perception. The drug is also reported to have a heavy body load at higher dosages. The drug is reported to be similar to those structurally similar to it.

pharmacology.text: 5-MeO-DiPT acts as a non-selective serotonin receptor agonist, including of the serotonin 5-HT1A, 5-HT1B, 5-HT1D, 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors, among others.
pharmacology.kind: Non-selective serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen; Entactogen; Stimulant

uses.text: The drug is usually taken orally, but may also be used by other routes. The drug was first encountered as a novel designer drug in 1999. It is used recreationally as a "party drug" and sexual enhancer, with notable use among gay men and transgender women as part of "chemsex", although its use in general has declined over time and is rare.
uses.recreational: Use of 5-MeO-DiPT has been found to be particularly prevalent among gay men who use drugs as part of chemsex. It is also seen in transgender women. The drug is described as a stimulant, sexual enhancer, party drug, and light psychedelic. 5-MeO-DiPT has been associated with increased risk of HIV diagnosis in multiple studies in Asia, perhaps due to risky sexual behavior involving the drug.

sideEffects.text: Flashbacks have been reported with 5-MeO-DiPT. There is a report of a prolonged delusional state associated with 5-MeO-DiPT.

summaryZh: 5-MeO-DiPT，化學名5-甲氧基-N,N-二異丙基色胺，是一種迷幻色胺，為二異丙基色胺的甲氧基衍生物。它有火狐狸、黑貓、煙斗等別稱，也是「0號膠囊」的主要成分。
summaryZhHans: 5-MeO-DiPT，化学名5-甲氧基-N,N-二异丙基色胺，是一种迷幻色胺，为二异丙基色胺的甲氧基衍生物。它有火狐狸、黑猫、烟斗等别称，也是“0号胶囊”的主要成分。

fact.en: Its nickname foxy comes from its abbreviation 5-MeO-DiPT, often shortened to foxy methoxy. Alexander Shulgin first made it and described it in TiHKAL.
fact.zh: 它的暱稱「foxy」源自縮寫5-MeO-DiPT，常被念成「foxy methoxy」。Alexander Shulgin首次合成了它，並在《TiHKAL》中加以描述。
